description: This file contains unit tests for the absl::StatusOr class, including tests for construction, assignment, move semantics, implicit conversions, and various edge cases. It also includes tests for related utility functions and type traits.

classes.name: CopyDetector
classes.description: A class used in tests to verify copy and move semantics, tracking whether it was copied or moved.

classes.name: CopyNoAssign
classes.description: A class with a copy constructor but deleted assignment operator, used to test copy semantics.

classes.name: InPlaceHelper
classes.description: A helper class for in-place construction tests, containing a vector and a unique pointer.

classes.name: Foo
classes.description: A simple class with an explicit constructor, used in in-place construction tests.

classes.name: ImplicitConstructibleFromA
classes.description: A class with implicit constructors from type A, used to test implicit conversions.

classes.name: ExplicitConstructibleFromA
classes.description: A class with explicit constructors from type A, used to test explicit conversions.

classes.name: ImplicitConstructibleFromBool
classes.description: A class implicitly constructible from bool, used in boolean conversion tests.

classes.name: ConvertibleToBool
classes.description: A class explicitly convertible to bool, used in boolean conversion tests.

classes.name: ExplicitConstructibleFromInt
classes.description: A class explicitly constructible from int, used in construction tests.

classes.name: MyType
classes.description: A simple type with an equality operator, used in conversion and construction tests.

classes.name: StatusOrConversionBase
classes.description: A template class providing implicit conversion to StatusOr<T> based on traits.

classes.name: ConversionBase
classes.description: A template class providing implicit conversion to T based on traits.

classes.name: StatusConversionBase
classes.description: A template class providing implicit conversion to absl::Status based on traits.

classes.name: CustomType
classes.description: A template class that conditionally provides conversions to StatusOr<T>, T, and Status based on configuration.

methods.name: ReturnUniquePtr
methods.description: Returns a StatusOr containing a unique_ptr to int, used in move semantics tests.

methods.name: CopyDetector
methods.description: Constructor and operators for tracking copy/move behavior.

methods.name: CopyNoAssign
methods.description: Constructor with copy semantics, no assignment operator.

methods.name: InPlaceHelper
methods.description: Constructor for in-place construction with initializer list and unique pointer.

methods.name: GetConvTraits
methods.description: Determines conversion traits based on bit flags and configuration.
